name: Alit
notes: A big-jawed two-legged hunter of the open eastern ground.
reaction_note: charges in pairs on open ground
den_note: A hollow on open ground where grazers feed.
territory_per_stretch_unit: groups per km of path or swim network in a matching band
why_here: Alit are native to Morrowind and Black Marsh; the eastern grassland staple.
sourcing_via: KotM alit mesh on the vanilla dog rig (plan §3.7 keepable)
sourcing_notes: Bone-name parity to be measured first.

name: Bog Blight
notes: A drowned Argonian corpse that walks once its grave-stake works loose.
reaction_note: closes on any living scent; a pahnjee rack masks the scent and turns it aside
den_note: An xul-vaat burial ground whose stakes the flood has tested; it rises where it was buried.
territory_per_stretch_unit: groups per km of path or swim network in a matching band
eaten_by: no predator; rats pick its leavings
why_here: Argonian dead whose stake came loose, dangerous in numbers; the marsh floods every wet season, so old grave fields are where they walk.
sourcing_via: vanilla draugr (meshes/actors/draugr) + BM&V troll/ghoul.nif re-material
sourcing_notes: Risen Argonian dead read as marsh-rotted draugr; the draugr clip set covers walk, wade and attacks.

name: Bog Dog
notes: A pack hunter that grows marsh plants in the fur of its back.
reaction_note: circles as a pack; howls bring the rest; breaks if two fall
den_note: A dry burrow in dense fern where the fern growing on its back hides it, near fellrunner fields.
territory_per_stretch_unit: groups per km of path or swim network in a matching band
why_here: Pack hunters with camouflaging vegetation growing in their back fur; a Blackwood staple; tameable and loyal.
sourcing_via: vanilla wolf (meshes/actors/canine/wolf) with its vanilla clips
sourcing_notes: No mesh grows plants in fur.
sourcing_redesign: A dark vanilla wolf; the back-growth is carried by where it lies (fern thickets) and its description, not by the model.

name: Crocodile
notes: A marsh crocodile two men long that lies still at the bank and lunges fast.
reaction_note: ambush from the water at a bank; breaks off and sinks if badly hurt
den_note: A sunning bank beside deep water with prey coming down to drink.
territory_per_stretch_unit: groups per km of path or swim network in a matching band
diet: fish, guar, waders, anything at the water's edge
harvest: hide (armour, travel bags), teeth (maturation-trial necklaces), tongue (food)
why_here: Two men long, fast, attacks inside town limits at Bogmother; Shadowfen ravines are crocodile-infested.
sourcing_via: BM&V vault slaughterfish/character assets/mihailcrocodile.nif (+ mihailcrocodileSALT)
sourcing_notes: Built on the slaughterfish skeleton, so swim and lunge clips come with it; KotM crocodile is a second variant.

name: Crow
notes: A black carrion bird that roosts by roads.
reaction_note: takes off calling and warns the road
den_note: A dead tree by a road where carrion lies.
territory_per_stretch_unit: groups per km of path or swim network in a matching band
why_here: Crows are part of Blackwood's staple fauna.
sourcing_via: vanilla crow (ambient critter)
sourcing_notes: Vanilla ambient bird.

name: Death Hopper
notes: A frog the size of a dog that waits under the water and spits poison.
reaction_note: ambush from under the surface; spits toxic globs at range, then closes as a pack
den_note: A still pond or seep deep enough to hide a frog while waders pass overhead.
territory_per_stretch_unit: groups per km of path or swim network in a matching band
diet: birds, rats, large prey swallowed whole
why_here: A notably large population around Gideon; lurk under the water, poisonous, spit over great distances, found in packs.
sourcing_via: HTBM vault pool htbm FrogSkeleton.nif with PoisonFrogBlue/Green/Red.nif, plus Toad.nif
sourcing_notes: Three colour variants; KotM frog is a second variant.

name: Dreugh
notes: A many-legged shelled sea creature that walks the seabed.
reaction_note: guards its seabed; follows into the shallows
den_note: A rocky hollow on the bay floor.
territory_per_stretch_unit: groups per km of path or swim network in a matching band
why_here: Dreugh are among the coast's swimmer threats.
sourcing_via: Sea of Spirits, Nexus SSE 4781 (sharks, dreugh, whales); not in the vault
sourcing_notes: Source before any placement; none placed in the slice.

name: Feather-Serpent
notes: A great serpent of the deep meres. Argonian stories give it feathers.
reaction_note: territorial; strikes anything that enters its mere and does not follow out of it
den_note: The deepest mere of the Hist forest, where nothing else hunts.
territory_per_stretch_unit: groups per km of path or swim network in a matching band
why_here: The sources say only that feather-serpents inhabit the depths of Black Marsh; ecology-encounters-loot names it Middle Argonia's free apex. Placed by hand only.
sourcing_via: no rig; delivered as the kaj-thux great-serpent build, BM&V vault snakes/character assets/oldsnake.nif at apex scale
sourcing_notes: A feathered flying serpent needs a new rig and flight clips. Redesigned: a colossal great serpent, its 'feathers' a story told about it, not shown.
sourcing_redesign: Shown as a colossal great serpent on the kaj-thux build; the feathers live in rumour and text only.

name: Fellrunner
notes: A pale, quick ground bird whose down hides a hunter's scent.
reaction_note: runs at once and calls; a fleeing flock warns the birds and beasts nearby
den_note: A scrape under dense fern near farm fields that supply its seed.
territory_per_stretch_unit: groups per km of path or swim network in a matching band
harvest: pale down (Murkwood hunter's armband); farmers trade sacks of it
why_here: Their pale down lets a hunter move through Murkwood undetected. Argonian farmers trade the feathers, so the birds live by the fields.
sourcing_via: BM&V vault chicken/dodo.nif on the vanilla chicken skeleton and clips, set fellrunner
sourcing_notes: The chicken rig has no attack or death clip.
sourcing_redesign: It never fights (fight 0), so its attack slot is the peck. It dies by settling into the sit-down clip, held on its last frame.

name: Fleshfly Swarm
notes: A red cloud of sand-grain flies that eat flesh.
reaction_note: a cloud that follows a warm body; the vile emollient repels it
den_note: Stagnant water beside carrion; the flies gather more thickly inland.
territory_per_stretch_unit: groups per km of path or swim network in a matching band
why_here: Red, sand-grain sized, in obscuring clouds; the Slough Point garrison lost ears and noses to them; they give mounts sloughskin.
sourcing_via: no rig; staged as a particle cloud plus a damage volume
sourcing_notes: An insect cloud is not an actor.
sourcing_redesign: A particle cloud with a damage volume, part of the attrition field rather than a creature with a body.

name: Giant Leech
notes: A leech as long as an arm that waits in dark water for a swimmer.
reaction_note: latches on and drains; slow on land
den_note: Dark still water with a steady trickle of scraps and swimmers.
territory_per_stretch_unit: groups per km of path or swim network in a matching band
why_here: The sources name giant leeches among Black Marsh's everyday hazards; they feed where scraps fall into still water.
sourcing_via: BM&V vault slaughterfish/character assets leech build
sourcing_notes: Rides the slaughterfish swim rig.

name: Giant Wasp
notes: A wasp the size of a pony that hunts from the canopy edge.
reaction_note: defends its nest hard; others join on the alarm buzz
den_note: A nest hung in a dead tree at a clearing edge with prey crossing open ground.
territory_per_stretch_unit: groups per km of path or swim network in a matching band
why_here: Giant wasps 'the size of ponies' are among Black Marsh's everyday hazards.
sourcing_via: vanilla chaurus (meshes/actors/chaurus) with its clips, set chaurus, wasp-amber tint
sourcing_notes: Every wasp body we hold is skinned to Dawnguard or Dragonborn bones, which we do not hold.
sourcing_redesign: A ground-hunting giant insect on the vanilla chaurus body, tinted wasp-amber: it hunts from the clearing edge on foot rather than from the air.

name: Guar
notes: A placid two-legged reptile kept in pens; its body warms a hatchery.
reaction_note: kept animals stay in their pen; a struck one bolts
den_note: Kept by people: a pen or awning in a settlement or work camp; wild Glowgills graze the Archon coast.
territory_per_stretch_unit: groups per km of path or swim network in a matching band
why_here: The Glowgill Guar of the Archon coast breathes underwater; the Ambergill is the Gideon and Murkmire golden variant.
sourcing_via: BM&V vault guars/guar.nif, histguar.nif, pond variants
sourcing_notes: Guar build with walk and graze clips; KotM guar a variant.

name: Hackwing
notes: A big bird with a saw-edged beak. It wounds its prey, flies off and returns.
reaction_note: bleed and withdraw: strikes, leaves, returns when the victim is weak
den_note: A dead-tree roost over open marsh with long sight lines over prey.
territory_per_stretch_unit: groups per km of path or swim network in a matching band
diet: fellrunners, young death hoppers, wounded travellers
eaten_by: no predator when grown; eggs to moon adders
harvest: supple leather (light armour, furniture), head plumage, feathers
why_here: Flocks that strike, fly off and return when the victim is mostly dead from blood loss; Murkmire and the grassland edge.
sourcing_via: vanilla dragon (meshes/actors/dragon) with its flight clips, set dragon, three-metre wingspan, dun tint
sourcing_notes: The BM&V cliff racer ships no skeleton or clips. Every other flyer body we hold is on Dawnguard or Dragonborn bones.
sourcing_redesign: A dun winged reptile on the vanilla dragon body at a three-metre wingspan; it still dives, strikes and climbs away.

name: Haj Mota
notes: A great armoured swamp turtle with a crushing bite.
reaction_note: ignores the distant; charges anyone who comes close or near its eggs
den_note: A sandy bank above the flood line beside slow water for laying.
territory_per_stretch_unit: groups per km of path or swim network in a matching band
eaten_by: geels-ha butcher eels in Kothringi folklore
harvest: shell (platters, shield bosses, whole shields); baby shells (bowls)
why_here: A large armoured swamp turtle-beast; its shells make the province's platters and shields.
sourcing_via: BM&V vault cow/Glyptodon and mudcrab character assets
sourcing_notes: Glyptodon body on a quadruped rig.

name: Haynekhtnamet
notes: The old wamasu of Shadowfen that villagers fed to hold back the floods.
reaction_note: electrifies its water; does not touch the offerings
den_note: The deepest flood channel near the offering shelf the villagers used.
territory_per_stretch_unit: groups per km of path or swim network in a matching band
why_here: The legendary wamasu of Shadowfen, given offerings to stop the seasonal flooding. Placed by hand, once.
sourcing_via: creature.wamasu build (HTBM Wamasu.nif/WamasuALT.nif), uniquely scaled and re-materialled
sourcing_notes: Unique scale of the wamasu build.

name: Hoarvor
notes: A swollen tick as big as a dog that feeds on carcasses and on any traveller close to its nest.
reaction_note: scuttles at any warm body close by and gives up the chase quickly
den_note: Where a bigger hunter leaves its kills: lair mouths, carcass heaps.
territory_per_stretch_unit: groups per km of path or swim network in a matching band
why_here: The sources name hoarvor among Black Marsh's everyday hazards; they gather where a predator leaves carcasses.
sourcing_via: BM&V vault mudcrab/character assets/parasite build
sourcing_notes: Rides the mudcrab rig.

name: Jassa Red Slug
notes: A red acid slug that slug-shapers use to carve wood and stone.
reaction_note: harmless unless handled bare; burns skin on touch
den_note: Rotting wood and wet stone in shade.
territory_per_stretch_unit: groups per km of path or swim network in a matching band
why_here: The acid-secreting slugs used in slug shaping.
sourcing_via: BM&V vault snail/slug.nif (+ slugskeleton)
sourcing_notes: Slug build.

name: Giant Snake
notes: A giant snake, long as a dozen cattle, that swallows its prey whole.
reaction_note: strikes and swallows; ignores what is too big or too far
den_note: Dense reedbed by water with abundant prey and no competing hunter.
territory_per_stretch_unit: groups per km of path or swim network in a matching band
why_here: Abundant prey and no competent predators have grown snakes 'a dozen cattle laid end to end'; Shadowfen's signature.
sourcing_via: BM&V vault snakes/character assets/snake.nif on the BM&V snake skeleton, set snake, eight metres
sourcing_notes: Serpent build; KotM giant snake a candidate variant.

name: Kotu Gava
notes: A whirring swarm of biting marsh insects.
reaction_note: a swarm that harries and thins with distance from water
den_note: Reeds over standing water where they breed.
territory_per_stretch_unit: groups per km of path or swim network in a matching band
why_here: The sources name kotu gava among the everyday insect hazards; KotM placed 23 of them in its exterior.
sourcing_via: no rig by design; KotM meganeura mesh dropped (no UESP basis, plan §3.7)
sourcing_notes: Staged as a particle swarm plus a damage volume.
sourcing_redesign: A particle swarm with a damage volume in the attrition field, like fleshflies.

name: Lamia
notes: A serpent-tailed hunter that lives in the caverns under ruins.
reaction_note: hunts in the dark; calls others in the warren
den_note: Caverns beneath a ruin, as under Loriasel.
territory_per_stretch_unit: groups per km of path or swim network in a matching band

sourcing_via: BM&V vault slaughterfish/rivnaga.nif
sourcing_notes: Serpent-bodied build on the slaughterfish rig.

name: Lizard-Steed
notes: A riding lizard that the Hist shaped to cross the marsh.

den_note: Kept by people in a stable or yard.
territory_per_stretch_unit: groups per km of path or swim network in a matching band

name: Marsh Giant

territory_per_stretch_unit: groups per km of path or swim network in a matching band

name: Marsh Rat

territory_per_stretch_unit: groups per km of path or swim network in a matching band
why_here: Rats hollow out a swamp leviathan's carcass from the inside.

sourcing_notes: Vanilla rig.

name: Medusa
notes: A serpent-bodied hunter of the Murkwood whose gaze stuns.

den_note: An overgrown ruin in the Murkwood.
territory_per_stretch_unit: groups per km of path or swim network in a matching band
why_here: Medusas are in Murkwood.
sourcing_via: BM&V vault snakes/character assets/snake.nif on the BM&V snake skeleton, set snake, three metres, moss-green tint
sourcing_notes: The rivnaga mesh is a feathered Quetzalcoatl that reads as a sea dragon.
sourcing_redesign: Shown on the serpent body at three metres, tinted moss-green.

name: Miregaunt

reaction_note: guards a set ground; never leaves it; returns after it falls
den_note: A ruin or grove a Hist would want guarded; its cavity may hold what it protects.
territory_per_stretch_unit: groups per km of path or swim network in a matching band
harvest: the contents of its midsection cavity (gem, relic or a living thing)
why_here: Murkmire's signature; tied to the Hist and part of the land; it returns after it is struck down.
sourcing_via: BM&V vault giant/character assets/treant.nif
sourcing_notes: Treant build on the giant rig.

name: Moon Adder

sourcing_via: BM&V vault snakes/character assets/snake.nif on the BM&V snake skeleton, set snake, one metre, pale tint

name: Mouth-Plover

name: Ripper Eel

territory_per_stretch_unit: groups per km of path or swim network in a matching band

territory_per_stretch_unit: groups per km of path or swim network in a matching band
why_here: Slaughterfish are the coast's staple swimmer threat.

sourcing_notes: Vanilla rig.
